theme: Three days of thinking before moving — practicing the strategic mindset

days.task: Before starting work today, spend 10 minutes asking: what is the single highest-leverage thing I could do? Then do that first.
Pick your most important current goal. Map out the next 30 days — identify the three moves that will matter most.
Identify one thing you're currently doing that doesn't serve your long-term goals. Write the case for stopping it.
